column2: The `putAll` method generates one entry access for each mapping in the specified map (`javadoc-linkedhashmap#class-linkedhashmap-k-v`).

After each value it moves one head across when needed so that the lower queue has the same size as the upper one or one element more, and it reads the median from the lower head when that queue is larger, or from the mean of the two heads when the sizes are equal.
